dimensions.criterion: Cold record creation: participants with no prior exposure produce CL1 records matching the answer key
Reviewer-verifiable: a reader who did not implement assigns verdict, level and governing requirement matching the answer key
Quickstart: the README's first section states what, who, status and limits; the quickstart runs on clean Python >= 3.10
Size budget: normative words, key words, terms and checker lines within the limits
One home, clearly separated: key words only in normative sections; no term defined twice; no two files contradict
Faithful to the site's commitments: every Appendix B item maps to a dispositioned Appendix A row
Every requirement has an evidence path: a check class and an outcome when evidence is missing
Levels are red-first: fixtures fail each level for one named reason; the schema is verified by a third-party validator
Checker correct against the answer key on every held-out case
Honest front matter: no adoption claims; licenses and self-state match the repository
Dogfooded, with a digest boundary: the release carries this job's own custody/v1 record, verified at CL1
Owner attention: decisions within bounds and every friction event answered

separationGaps: the bar's author (Claude Opus 5.5) is also the maker (the Architect = Maker conflict, recorded again);
one person (Steve Moitozo II) holds the Owner, buyer-proxy and specialist-adopter seats, and approved the bar in both approval roles;
the human reader had not returned readings when this record was built, so the human half of D1 and the human reading of the reader gates are not in it;

the exposed case and the orchestrator-specified case are not blind (the orchestrator supplied their content after reading the candidate and the checker), so both are held out of D9's verdict and reported separately; and the first Decision-6 key pass is not blind (its clean-room input carried the checker's own per-case output), so it is logged as superseded and its corrections are not used;

an interrogatory that probed instrument internals was answered in the Owner channel with held-out detail before its recipient was established; the Owner confirmed none of it reached the maker (log events 45-46), a near-miss, recorded;
the evaluator scripts' author (DeepSeek v4.1, the orchestrator) also handled the key and the plants;
the seated reader panel is four AI models from the same provider path as the makers' reviewers, and the gate readings rest on a split panel (D2 and D5/D6 differ across readers).
The guide test (S1) had no planted control; its reviewer's reading is uncalibrated.
